messages:
cora-peopleops: Heads-up — companywide Data Protection & Attestation window is open from Apr 1–Apr 14. Everyone with Redwood accounts must either confirm their role status or upload the required evidence by Apr 14 23:59 UTC. https://redwood.example.com/internal/attestations :calendar: 

cora-peopleops: What we need from you: short answers + attachments. For most folks it's a 2-step flow: 1) Complete the Privacy/Security attestation form (link above). 2) Upload any supporting artifacts to the Evidence Locker (S3 link in the form). If you manage systems, include an owner and a one-line description of controls.

cora-peopleops: Key notes: contractors have a separate checkbox; if you're a contractor tag @people-ops in the form for exceptions. Team leads, please confirm staff who report to you.

alex-engineering: Quick Q — can we get a 48h grace for infra contractors? their onboarding overlaps the window.

cora-peopleops: @alex-engineering we can grant a limited extension for contractors if leads flag them in the form by Apr 10. Please add names + start dates in the free text field.

sam-security: Minimum evidence for infra folks: asset inventory export OR a screenshot of the CMDB entry + one policy doc showing access control. For app teams: data flow diagram or README + copy of encryption-at-rest setting. If unsure ping security.

ria-privacy: Reminder: annual privacy training must be completed before you attest. If you haven't finished training, the attestation form will surface a link to the micro-course (15–20 mins). Deadline for training is Apr 12 to allow time to upload proof.

alex-engineering: Thanks — we'll triage on the eng side and collect artifacts. I’ll ping leads to consolidate.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Attestation window opens — complete form & evidence" will post in #general and email on Apr 8 at 10:00 UTC.

cora-peopleops: Office hours: Apr 6 16:00–17:00 UTC (drop-in) with people-ops + security to help triage questions. Link in the form. If you need a private review, request a slot using the form.

sam-security: If you're unsure whether a doc qualifies, upload it and mark it as "for review" — we'll follow up. We aim to close reviews by Apr 20.

cora-peopleops: TL;DR: complete attestation form + upload evidence by Apr 14 23:59 UTC; training done by Apr 12; contractors flag by Apr 10; office hours Apr 6. Thanks everyone — please share this with any external collaborators you manage. :thumbsup:
